name: @ust-protocol/rfc6962-verify
description: The RFC 6962 CONSTRUCTION connector for UST anchor proofs — answers 'is this content_hash a member of that root?' for the `rfc6962-raw` tree. Zero-dep, no network, no substrate. The other axis (is the ROOT committed, and when?) is a substrate connector's job.

ust:browser.why: The climb uses node:crypto for SHA-256 and the Buffer global. A browser build is a separate export rather than a port of this one, because in a browser SHA-256 is asynchronous and the connector must therefore be async — which the core's inclusion seam admits as of round 236 (UST-Protocol#173).
